name: Pellsin Yuzu-Mango Haze
manufacturer: Pellsin Drinks Co. (Corponation subsidiary — NutraCal Group)
description: A mass-market citrus-tropical soda from NutraCal's mid-tier Pellsin line, blending synth-yuzu with real mango extract at a price point accessible to Tier 2. The haze refers to a slight natural cloudiness engineered into the formula.
flavor_profile: Bright yuzu zest up front, thick mango sweetness mid-palate, a faint floral haze on the finish — slightly pulpy in texture
cultural_context: Pellsin Haze is the soda you grab from a vending column without thinking. It's not exciting but it's reliable — Tier 2 offices stock it in break rooms. There's a running joke that you can tell someone's had a bad meeting by how fast they finish a Pellsin Haze.
story_hooks: NutraCal quietly reformulated Pellsin Haze eight months ago — cutting real mango extract by 40% — and a grassroots consumer group is running lab tests to prove it, threatening a corponation PR crisis
A Tier 3 food blogger who claimed Pellsin Haze caused a mild allergic reaction disappeared before publishing her findings; her drafts are now circulating in encrypted forums
The vending column algorithm in a specific Midlake district has been recommending Pellsin Haze to everyone regardless of purchase history — someone has been manipulating the preference engine
